onset_event_names: Tanker War / Operation Earnest Will begins
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Tanker War / Operation Earnest Will begins
event_names: Tanker War / Operation Earnest Will begins
rationales: Iran-Iraq Tanker War attacks and U.S. escort mission for Kuwaiti oil tankers; oil relevance is via Persian Gulf tanker security rather than measured global production loss.

onset_event_names: U.S.-Iran naval escalation during Tanker War / Operation Praying Mantis context
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: U.S.-Iran naval escalation during Tanker War / Operation Praying Mantis context
event_names: U.S.-Iran naval escalation during Tanker War / Operation Praying Mantis context
rationales: Escalation of U.S.-Iran naval conflict in the Persian Gulf during the 1987-88 tanker escort episode; oil relevance is shipping/chokepoint security.

onset_event_names: Iraq invades Kuwait
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Iraq invades Kuwait
event_names: Iraq invades Kuwait
rationales: Actual invasion plus continuing Gulf supply risk; EIA says nearly all Kuwait and Iraq production was taken offline after the invasion.

onset_event_names: Gulf War / Operation Desert Storm and Kuwait oil disruption episode
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Gulf War / Operation Desert Storm and Kuwait oil disruption episode
event_names: Gulf War / Operation Desert Storm and Kuwait oil disruption episode
rationales: Realized war and continuing oil-supply risk following the Kuwait invasion; included as the conflict/action quarter rather than just the initial invasion quarter.

onset_event_names: 9/11 terrorist attacks
event_names: 9/11 terrorist attacks
rationales: GPA terrorist act and continuing GPT risk; oil relevance is mixed because ECB notes an initial Brent increase followed by a demand-concern decline.

onset_event_names: Venezuela PDVSA general strike begins | Iraq War buildup and Gulf supply-risk premium
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Venezuela PDVSA general strike begins
event_names: Venezuela PDVSA general strike begins | Iraq War buildup and Gulf supply-risk premium
rationales: Realized disruption in a major oil producer; Hamilton reports 2.1 mb/d of Venezuelan production was eliminated in Dec 2002-Jan 2003. | Threat-only quarter: military buildup and expected Iraq/Gulf supply risk before the U.S.-led invasion.

onset_event_names: U.S.-led Iraq War begins
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: U.S.-led Iraq War begins
event_names: Venezuela PDVSA strike continues | U.S.-led Iraq War begins
rationales: Continuation of the realized Venezuelan production disruption into Jan 2003. | Realized beginning of war plus continuing future supply/security risk.

event_names: Iraq War production disruption continues
rationales: Hamilton reports the U.S. attack on Iraq removed an additional 2.2 mb/d over April-July 2003.

onset_event_names: Libya civil unrest / civil war disrupts oil production
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Libya civil unrest / civil war disrupts oil production
event_names: Libya civil unrest / civil war disrupts oil production
rationales: Realized conflict plus continuing risk; EIA reports Libyan oil/gas production fell an estimated 60-90 percent after unrest began.

onset_event_names: Iran threatens Strait of Hormuz amid oil-sanctions escalation
event_names: Iran threatens Strait of Hormuz amid oil-sanctions escalation
rationales: Threat-only: Iranian officials threatened to close Hormuz if sanctions were imposed on Iran's oil exports.

event_names: Hormuz closure threat and naval tension continues
rationales: Threat-only continuation of December 2011-January 2012 Hormuz closure threats and naval escalation risk.

onset_event_names: EU embargo and tightened sanctions on Iranian oil implemented
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: EU embargo and tightened sanctions on Iranian oil implemented
event_names: EU embargo and tightened sanctions on Iranian oil implemented
rationales: Act-only by narrative rule: sanctions implementation; EIA says sanctions in late 2011 and mid-2012 sharply reduced Iranian production/exports.

onset_event_names: Libya oil-port strikes and export blockades
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Libya oil-port strikes and export blockades
event_names: Libya oil-port strikes and export blockades
rationales: EIA reports prolonged strikes at Libyan loading ports from late July removed more than 1 million b/d from the global market.

event_names: Libya port blockades and crude outages continue
rationales: Continuation of Libyan port blockade/outage episode that EIA links to Brent market tightness.

onset_event_names: Russia annexes Crimea / Russia energy-sanctions risk
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Russia annexes Crimea / Russia energy-sanctions risk
event_names: Russia annexes Crimea / Russia energy-sanctions risk
rationales: Realized annexation plus sanctions/energy-security threat; oil relevance is medium because 2014 sanctions were energy-sector related but did not create a clean immediate crude supply outage.

onset_event_names: ISIS offensive in Iraq / Mosul and Iraqi oil-supply concerns
event_names: ISIS offensive in Iraq / Mosul and Iraqi oil-supply concerns
rationales: Actual insurgent advance plus supply threat; EIA says 2014 crude prices peaked in June primarily because of internal conflict in Iraq and concerns over Iraqi production disruption.

onset_event_names: Yemen civil war and Saudi-led intervention / Bab el-Mandeb risk
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Yemen civil war and Saudi-led intervention / Bab el-Mandeb risk
event_names: Yemen civil war and Saudi-led intervention / Bab el-Mandeb risk
rationales: Realized conflict and transport-route risk; EIA says nearly all Yemen oil/gas fields were shut in in 2015 and notes Yemen's Bab el-Mandeb location.

onset_event_names: Niger Delta Avengers / Nigerian oil infrastructure attacks
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Niger Delta Avengers / Nigerian oil infrastructure attacks
event_names: Niger Delta Avengers / Nigerian oil infrastructure attacks
rationales: Actual militant attacks plus continuing threat to oil infrastructure; EIA expected Nigerian production to remain depressed through 2017 because of militant attacks.

onset_event_names: U.S. withdrawal from JCPOA and reimposition path for Iran oil sanctions
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: U.S. withdrawal from JCPOA and reimposition path for Iran oil sanctions
event_names: U.S. withdrawal from JCPOA and reimposition path for Iran oil sanctions
rationales: Sanctions policy action plus threat to future Iranian oil exports; oil relevance through Iran exports and Hormuz risk.

onset_event_names: U.S. sanctions on Venezuela / PdVSA
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: U.S. sanctions on Venezuela / PdVSA
event_names: U.S. sanctions on Venezuela / PdVSA
rationales: Act-only by narrative rule: sanctions implementation affecting Venezuela's oil industry/imports; EIA expected 2019 declines to accelerate as sanctions-related deadlines passed.

onset_event_names: Iran oil-sanctions waivers expire and Gulf of Oman tanker attacks
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Iran oil-sanctions waivers expire and Gulf of Oman tanker attacks
event_names: Iran oil-sanctions waivers expire and Gulf of Oman tanker attacks
regions: Iran / Gulf of Oman / Strait of Hormuz
rationales: Waivers expired in May 2019 and tanker attacks occurred in June; EIA notes Iranian exports fell after waiver expiry and Reuters reports tanker attacks drove up oil prices and confrontation risk.

onset_event_names: Abqaiq-Khurais attack on Saudi Aramco
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Abqaiq-Khurais attack on Saudi Aramco
event_names: Abqaiq-Khurais attack on Saudi Aramco
rationales: Actual oil facility attack plus continuing escalation risk; EIA says Abqaiq capacity was about 7 million b/d, about 7% of global crude production capacity.

onset_event_names: U.S. killing of Qasem Soleimani and Iran-U.S. escalation | Libya blockade closes export ports and major fields
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: U.S. killing of Qasem Soleimani and Iran-U.S. escalation | Libya blockade closes export ports and major fields
event_names: U.S. killing of Qasem Soleimani and Iran-U.S. escalation | Libya blockade closes export ports and major fields
rationales: Actual military action plus supply-disruption risk; EIA uses this episode to illustrate how disruption risk can immediately affect oil prices even without barrels removed. | Realized blockade/shut-in plus continuing civil-war risk; EIA says Libya output fell to around 100,000 b/d after ports closed and fields were shut in.

onset_event_names: Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine
event_names: Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine
rationales: Actual invasion plus continuing sanctions/export risk; EIA says geopolitical risk related to Russia's further invasion contributed to higher and more volatile crude oil prices.

onset_event_names: EU embargo and G7 price cap on Russian crude oil begins
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: EU embargo and G7 price cap on Russian crude oil begins
event_names: EU embargo and G7 price cap on Russian crude oil begins
rationales: Energy sanctions implementation plus continuing export/rerouting threat; EU/G7 caps applied from 5 Dec 2022 for crude oil.

onset_event_names: Hamas attack on Israel and Israel-Gaza war risk premium | Houthi Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb shipping attacks begin
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Hamas attack on Israel and Israel-Gaza war risk premium | Houthi Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb shipping attacks begin
event_names: Hamas attack on Israel and Israel-Gaza war risk premium | Houthi Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb shipping attacks begin
regions: Israel / Gaza / Middle East | Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb / Yemen
rationales: Terrorist act and war escalation risk; IEA says the 7 Oct attack caused traders to price a $3-4/bbl risk premium, though without direct physical supply impact. | Actual attacks and continuing chokepoint threat; EIA notes late-2023 Red Sea attacks raised insurance costs, rerouting and Brent price pressure.

onset_event_names: Red Sea disruption intensifies; U.S.-UK strikes against Houthi targets
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Red Sea disruption intensifies; U.S.-UK strikes against Houthi targets
event_names: Red Sea disruption intensifies; U.S.-UK strikes against Houthi targets
rationales: Continuing route attacks and military escalation; EIA reports crude oil flows through Bab el-Mandeb fell in December and shipping times/freight rates increased.

onset_event_names: Iran-Israel direct missile/drone exchange and regional escalation risk
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Iran-Israel direct missile/drone exchange and regional escalation risk
event_names: Iran-Israel direct missile/drone exchange and regional escalation risk
rationales: Actual direct attack plus continuing escalation/Hormuz risk; Reuters notes Brent reached recent highs before Iran's response and then retreated after damage proved limited.

onset_event_names: Libya political dispute shuts oilfields/ports
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Libya political dispute shuts oilfields/ports
event_names: Libya political dispute shuts oilfields/ports
rationales: Actual oilfield/port shutdown and continuing political risk; Reuters reported major Libyan ports halted exports and production fell sharply in Aug-Sep 2024.

event_names: Red Sea oil flows remain significantly reduced
rationales: Continuing actual route disruption and threat; EIA says oil flows through Bab el-Mandeb averaged 4.0 million b/d through Aug 2024 versus 8.7 million b/d in 2023.

onset_event_names: New U.S./UK Russia oil sanctions and shadow-fleet measures
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: New U.S./UK Russia oil sanctions and shadow-fleet measures
event_names: New U.S./UK Russia oil sanctions and shadow-fleet measures
rationales: Energy sanctions act plus continuing export threat; EIA Russia overview reports new U.S./UK measures in Jan 2025 supporting existing price caps/export bans.

onset_event_names: Israel strikes Iran; U.S. strikes Iran; Iran response and ceasefire | Strait of Hormuz risk highlighted amid regional conflict
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: Israel strikes Iran; U.S. strikes Iran; Iran response and ceasefire
event_names: Israel strikes Iran; U.S. strikes Iran; Iran response and ceasefire | Strait of Hormuz risk highlighted amid regional conflict
regions: Iran / Israel / Strait of Hormuz | Strait of Hormuz
rationales: Actual strikes plus Hormuz/supply-disruption threat; IEA says Brent rallied after Israel's 13 June strikes; EIA says after U.S. strikes and Iran response a ceasefire reduced Middle East supply-disruption risk. | Threat-only coding for the transport-risk component: EIA says Hormuz carried about 20% of global petroleum liquids consumption in 2024 and remained critical in 2025Q1.

onset_event_names: EU 18th sanctions package lowers Russia oil price cap and targets shadow fleet
realized_oil_shock_onset_names: EU 18th sanctions package lowers Russia oil price cap and targets shadow fleet
event_names: EU 18th sanctions package lowers Russia oil price cap and targets shadow fleet
rationales: Energy sanctions implementation plus continuing export/rerouting threat; EIA notes the EU 18th package in July 2025 lowered Russia oil price cap and increased shadow-fleet measures.
